claims.claimText: For Qatar University AI Research and Innovation Hub resources, the terms state that requested resources are for specified research projects, required IRB or ethics approvals must be obtained before use, and project data must follow Qatar University data protection, privacy, research governance, IT security, acceptable-use, and data-handling policies.
claims.claimValue: AI Hub resource-use terms for research approvals and data handling

evidence.evidenceSnippet: The requested resources will be used solely for the research project(s) specified in this request. All required approvals, including IRB or other applicable ethics approvals, have been obtained prior to using these resources. All data stored, processed, or analyzed using these resources has been lawfully obtained and will be handled in accordance with Qatar University's data protection, privacy, and research governance policies. All project members will comply with Qatar University's IT security, acceptable use, and data-handling policies.
